name: SNMPNetworkInterfaces
title: SNMPNetworkInterfaces - Global
summary: The SNMPNetworkInterfaces script include provides methods to create network interfaces for JavaScript SNMP sensors.
overview: Use this script include in discovery scripts when you need to create network interfaces for JavaScript SNMP sensors.
